protocol.split: V2 main val (283 samples, 10 objects); test untouched
protocol.metric: standardized MAE over all scored (sample, parameter) entries in specific space (E/rho, nu, rho, sigma_y/rho; ln1p + train z-score); rho is an expected-unidentifiable control
protocol.within_law_r: Pearson r inside each GT law, averaged over laws (scripts/audit_within_law.py)
protocol.selection: trained runs: epoch with best val standardized MAE (same rule as V2 main report); deterministic baselines: none
protocol.bootstrap: paired object bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 17) of object-macro MAE difference method - V-JEPA C; negative favors V-JEPA C
protocol.caveat: only 10 val objects: object bootstrap CIs are wide; val is also the selection split for trained runs
